name: zod
description: TypeScript-first schema declaration and validation library with static type inference and LLM structured output support.
author: Awesome API Skills Team
pitfalls: Using z.string().optional() with OpenAI Structured Outputs (strict mode requires .nullable() instead of .optional())
Calling schema.parse() on untrusted HTTP request bodies without try/catch instead of schema.safeParse()
Forgetting z.coerce.number() when validating URL query parameters or formData strings
checklist: Static TypeScript types derived via z.infer<typeof Schema>
Query/URL string parameters coerced using z.coerce.number() or z.coerce.boolean()
